units: body px (parts/cc/body.png px of the side-view spud); dir/aim = screen deg, y down, 0 = right (facing), -90 = up
mirror: every slot is side +1 (facing right); nothing is mirrored per slot. When the target is behind the hero (or it walks left) the game mirrors the WHOLE composite (body cell + all arms) about the anchor x, exactly like it already does for sheets; aim maths stays in the unmirrored frame (mirror the target x about the anchor first). See compose_ref.MultiArm.frame(facing=-1).

layers.front: near side: drawn over the body (z > behindBodyZ), light arm + bud
layers.back: far side: behind the body (z < behindBodyZ), dark arm + dark hand

raised.note: keys with raised:true on a FRONT-layer arm swap the arm for this painting (club over the shoulder); the weapon goes through its fist, behind the body
raised.backNote: weapons_v2: back-layer slots on raised:true keys swap their arm for this dark painting (same rule as front: placed at the slot with shoulder on the slot, rotated by rrot; weapon through its grip at weaponZ). Before this, back slots dropped raised and used raise/elbow.

pass9: art pass 9 weapon spread (tools/pass9/spread_apply.py): sprouted slot pos/dir re-laid out, far native arm overridden for 2..6 weapons, per-slot rest wrist offsets baked into body_track (slots[*].pass9 lists them). Same schema; no code change needed for the spread.
